description: Source code implementing ext2 filesystem disk operations, including reading/writing superblocks, block groups, inodes, and managing blocks and inodes (allocation, freeing, removal).

methods.name: fill_sblock
methods.description: Populates in-memory superblock structure from disk superblock data, converting from little-endian.

methods.name: fill_disk_sblock
methods.description: Populates disk superblock data from in-memory superblock structure, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: fill_bgroup
methods.description: Populates in-memory block group structure from disk data.

methods.name: fill_disk_bgroup
methods.description: Populates disk block group data from in-memory structure.

methods.name: fill_inode
methods.description: Fills in-memory inode structure from disk inode data, converting from little-endian.

methods.name: fill_disk_inode
methods.description: Fills disk inode data from in-memory inode structure, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_direntry
methods.description: Converts disk directory entry to in-memory directory entry, validating name length.

methods.name: ext2_write_direntry
methods.description: Writes in-memory directory entry data into disk directory entry structure.

methods.name: ext2_get_disk_direntry_inode
methods.description: Retrieves inode number from disk directory entry, converting from little-endian.

methods.name: ext2_get_disk_direntry_reclen
methods.description: Retrieves record length from disk directory entry, converting from little-endian.

methods.name: ext2_get_disk_direntry_namelen
methods.description: Retrieves name length from disk directory entry.

methods.name: ext2_get_disk_direntry_type
methods.description: Retrieves file type from disk directory entry.

methods.name: ext2_set_disk_direntry_inode
methods.description: Sets inode number in disk directory entry, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: ext2_set_disk_direntry_reclen
methods.description: Sets record length in disk directory entry, converting to little-endian.

methods.name: ext2_set_disk_direntry_namelen
methods.description: Sets name length in disk directory entry.

methods.name: ext2_set_disk_direntry_type
methods.description: Sets file type in disk directory entry.

methods.name: ext2_set_disk_direntry_name
methods.description: Copies name into disk directory entry.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_superblock
methods.description: Reads superblock from disk into in-memory structure, handling offset based on block size.

methods.name: get_ngroups
methods.description: Calculates total number of block groups based on superblock data.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_block_group
methods.description: Fetches and caches block group data, reading from disk if not cached.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_bg_itable
methods.description: Fetches inode table block for a block group, caching it.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_bg_ibitmap
methods.description: Fetches inode bitmap block for a block group, caching it.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_bg_bbitmap
methods.description: Fetches block bitmap block for a block group, caching it.

methods.name: get_itable_entry
methods.description: Calculates inode's block group and index within the inode table.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_inode
methods.description: Fetches inode data from disk and populates in-memory inode structure.

methods.name: fetch_level_blocks
methods.description: Recursively fetches data blocks for an inode based on block offsets and level.

methods.name: ext2_fetch_inode_block
methods.description: Fetches a specific data block of an inode, caching it for efficiency.

methods.name: all_zero
methods.description: Checks if all elements in offsets array up to given level are zero.

methods.name: delete_blocks
methods.description: Recursively deletes blocks referenced by inode, freeing them and updating bitmap.

methods.name: get_level_offsets
methods.description: Calculates level-specific offsets for a given block number based on filesystem parameters.

methods.name: block0_level
methods.description: Determines the level of a block based on its number.

methods.name: ext2_inode_remove_blocks
methods.description: Removes all blocks from an inode starting from a specified block number.

methods.name: alloc_level_blocks
methods.description: Allocates data blocks for an inode at the current level, updating inode structure.

methods.name: ext2_commit_superblock
methods.description: Writes the in-memory superblock back to disk.

methods.name: ext2_commit_bg
methods.description: Commits block group data to disk.

methods.name: ext2_commit_inode
methods.description: Commits inode data to disk.

methods.name: ext2_commit_inode_block
methods.description: Commits inode's data block, allocating blocks if necessary.

methods.name: ext2_clear_inode
methods.description: Clears inode data on disk.

methods.name: ext2_alloc_block
methods.description: Allocates a free block from the filesystem, updating bitmaps and superblock.

methods.name: ext2_free_block
methods.description: Frees a block, updating bitmaps and superblock.

methods.name: ext2_free_inode
methods.description: Frees an inode, updating bitmaps and inode table.
